system.description:
During this main process you can add a [Throwing] tag to one [Shield] you're equipped with and use it as a weapon with [Range: 2Sq.] that can use [Ranged attack]. That [Attack Power] is equal to [Physical Defense] of [Shield].

A skill that throws a shield to attack distant enemies. By attaching a chain to pull it, or by devising a way to throw it like a boomerang, the shield will immediately return to your hand.
